amendment.approval: Owner approved the exact quadratic capped work-policy amendment on 2026-09-30, as communicated by the parent integration task. Approval does not waive independent review.

policy: A successful pair has identical profile and source outside one declared field after sorting only specification sets; source handles are kept fixed. Its full canonical RDF dataset and full canonical bytes differ. All selected witnesses reproduce under the independent producer and typed handle/set/key permutations. This deliberately undercounts pairs needing handle alignment or coordinated signature/topology edits. Composite field substitution is evidence for that owning field only, never automatic evidence for nested fields. Primary id values are excluded by A1/A6; canonical envelope fields mirror source/profile framing and are not counted twice.
profileFramingGap: A dedicated paired root-profile framing counterexample remains separate: changing selected profile also requires complete artifact state, so it is not an isolated retained source field mutation. Successful structural/artifact fixtures alone are not claimed as a one-field proof.
qualification: D18.1 remains open wherever entries say unclosed. A10 finite grammar coverage and 29 embedded assertion additions do not establish exhaustive mapping injectivity.
